name: Leighbet
description: An ambitious Izzet attendant and former analyst who discovers rift-tainted plants that confer immunity to electricity, runs an unsanctioned lab, kills test subjects and finally kills the Dimir spy Tamsyn.

timeline.summary: Leighbet, moonlighting as an analyst, follows the Golgari troll Kel'teth through the Tenth District sewers to find what is making fatbergs immune to electricity.
timeline.quote: No time for gawking, I'm afraid,

timeline.summary: Kel'teth saves Leighbet from a sewer siren by throwing cement at it.
timeline.quote: Rabid as all get-out, but they can't attack you unless you put your hand in their mouth.

timeline.summary: Leighbet scans a fatberg and detects a powerful, unrecognized arcane trace, then leaves the sleeping Kel'teth to follow it.
timeline.quote: whatever's causing this sizzle is powerful.

timeline.summary: Leighbet opens a grate with stored mana, finds a spatial rift ringed by plants, and survives an eel shock after her canister explodes.
timeline.quote: For a long, long moment, my entire body seizes up and my world goes white.

timeline.summary: Leighbet deduces that contact with the rift made the plants, and over time the fatbergs, immune to electricity and takes samples.
timeline.quote: Contact with the rift must have imbued them with immunity to electrical magic.

timeline.summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.
timeline.quote: that just leaves you standing at the front steps of the Lightning Rod, a box full of your desk belongings in your arms.

timeline.summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.
timeline.quote: Tamsyn Sweene. Call me Tammy, and we've got a problem.

timeline.summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
timeline.quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
timeline.quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
timeline.quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

timeline.summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.
timeline.quote: my teeth are reshuffling, becoming jagged and ragged like a mouthful of fangs.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn finds Leighbet in the sewers and reveals she is a shapeshifting Dimir spy who never was a blastseeker.
timeline.quote: There was no chemister, Leighbet. I never was a blastseeker.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn attacks Leighbet with electricity and declares the serum a Dimir discovery; an arc drake's electric breath hits them in the water.
timeline.quote: your serum is a Dimir discovery now. Goodbye, Leighbet.

timeline.summary: Leighbet builds a makeshift ballast from sewer junk, stuns Tamsyn with a thrown welding jar and redirects her own blast back at her.
timeline.quote: When the next blast orb comes, I meet it with my makeshift ballast.

timeline.summary: Leighbet's Simic transformation wears off, and she kills Tamsyn by snapping her spine to keep the discovery from Dimir.
timeline.quote: as Tamsyn's vertebrae snap, I take comfort that she doesn't know pain for long.

relations.note: She breaks Tamsyn's neck in the sewers.
relations.quote: as Tamsyn's vertebrae snap, I take comfort that she doesn't know pain for long.

relations.note: She was his attendant before being fired.
relations.quote: I serve as an attendant to Master Dax Foley, a high-level chemister

relations.note: A lowly attendant until she is dismissed.
relations.quote: I'd be lying if I said I hadn't noticed the pressure mounting within the Izzet League lately

relations.note: She tries to kill Leighbet and steal her serum.
relations.quote: A mind like yours is a terrible thing to waste

pages_say.description: An ambitious Izzet attendant and former analyst who discovers rift-tainted plants that confer immunity to electricity, runs an unsanctioned lab, kills test subjects and finally kills the Dimir spy Tamsyn.
